rows: That is a different offer. The answer to that one is no.
Brawling is a term in an agreement. I do not accept it unless the terms are written down.
A risk is an obligation. Before I accept one, I want it stated in full.
Pace is part of the contract. Who has the right to change it?
The people are the party to this contract who pay the most. I expect them to be treated fairly.
Short version: the terms are set, and I do not accept changes without notice.
I secure my position through terms I can rely on. I am not going to give them up.
Look at my stance. It is the stance of someone who reads the small print.
You say technique. Name the term that defines it, and I will consider the claim.
Strikes are within the agreed terms. Nothing beyond them is.
A risk I did not agree to is not my risk. Make it explicit or drop it.
A stall is a breach of the agreed pace. I do not accept it.
The people deserve a contest under clear terms. I will insist on that.
You say I am irrelevant. My position is secured by terms, and I intend to keep them.
You are proud of your {strength}. Fine. State the term it relies on, and I will respond to that term.
I have read your {strength} against the agreed terms, and it falls short on one clause.
You kept calm. Good. Calm is a term I can hold you to.
Fair. That term is accepted, in writing, and it stands.
I could refuse that outright. I will state the position and leave it there.
One fall. Those are the terms. Keep me down and you have met them.
On the mat, the terms remain as written. Hold to them.
Grounded or standing, the terms do not change without my consent.
Stay in front of me and meet the terms in full.
Good answer. It meets the terms.
You have not answered. The terms require an answer. Give it.
I accept that. It will be tested at the bell, under the terms.
I will wrestle this match under the agreed terms, and I will finish it on those terms.
My approach is precise. I say what I accept, and I stand by it.
Whatever happens, the record will show what was agreed.
The terms are not yet complete. One clause remains open.
I have one more term to state, and you will hear it when the bell rings.
